about: v84k skill bar (js/ab-skillbar.js, js/ab-hudarc.js, js/ab-skilltree.js). hud.order: leftToRight puts HUD slot 1 (#skill-0, hotkey 1) leftmost and slot 4 rightmost, matching the 1-4 picker in the skill screen; 'arc' keeps the old angle order. respec: the skill screen's Hold to respec refunds tree points only (stats, gear and non-tree buffs stay); costPerLevel x level gold, same as before. rememberBar puts each skill back in the slot it had once it is learned again. cooldown: the overlay on each HUD skill button. Colours are CSS colours; sizes are CSS px; times in ms or s as named. v84n one-tap equip: picker.closeOnAssign 'always' closes the skill screen after a skill is put on the bar (no window left to close); 'fromHud' only when the screen was opened from an empty HUD slot; 'never' keeps it open. Tapping an empty HUD slot opens the skill screen in equip mode: tapping any learned active skill there puts it straight in that slot (picker.equipHint is the line shown).

respec.toast: Tree points refunded. Your stats and gear stay.

picker.label: Put on the action bar
picker.equipHint: Tap a skill to put it in slot {n}

ult.about: v84n: the ultimate's own HUD button (hotkey 5), apart from slots 1-4. It shows the owned ACTIVE ultimate, is locked before one is learned (40 points in a tree), and a passive ultimate shows as always on. Placed on a ring around Strike, clear of the HUD, the Dynamic Island / safe area and the quest pill.
ult.label: Ultimate
ult.lockedToast: Your ultimate unlocks at 40 points in a tree.
ult.passiveToast: Your ultimate is passive, and it is always on.
ult.barRefuse: Ultimates go on their own button (5), not slots 1-4.
